verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should: can, brand, headline, badges, then a prominent CTA on the right. Its flaws are that the body copy is so small it's barely readable, the backdrop circle is clipped at the top and bottom edges, and the badges float in the middle, cut off from their copy. B splits the product art apart, leaving an empty green circle on the left and a bare can stranded on the far right. It also puts the headline above the SOLSTICE wordmark, shrinks the CTA into a small pill in the badge row so it's buried, and its body text is tiny and illegible.
